body:
one year ago today: a mint-green briefcase, opened on camera, and album twelve inside it.

august 13, 2025. her first podcast appearance ever — new heights, her boyfriend's own show. she pulled the blurred briefcase from behind the desk and there it was: an orange "TS," a title — the life of a showgirl — and an october 3 date. twelve tracks, the last one with sabrina carpenter on it.

the livestream buckled at 1.3 million watching at once, a number guinness certified as the most concurrent views a podcast has ever had on youtube. around thirteen million views inside a day.

everything showgirl since — ophelia, the release-party weekend at the box office, the four-million week — traces back to this one episode. the whole year sits sourced on the era timeline: longlivets.com/?era=tloas

📷 taylor on late night with seth meyers, october 2025 — lloyd bishop/nbc via getty images
why: One-year anniversary of the New Heights announcement (Aug 13, 2025), the biggest single story of the current era. Every claim traces to the Vault TLOAS item "A mint-green briefcase on New Heights: album No. 12, announced on her first-ever podcast" (sourced NBC News/Guinness; 13M-views figure per Variety in the item context; 12 tracks + Sabrina Carpenter feature + Oct 3 date all in the same item). Distinct angle from the posted tloas-countdown X item (which covered the Aug 12 countdown; this covers the episode itself). Photo: real credited Getty photo of Taylor from the repo corpus (lenses.ts tloas entry), Showgirl-era press run. First post under the 2026-08-12 Taylor-photo standard.
